definitions.gloss: number, issue (of a magazine or publication)
definitions.explanation: A sequential number assigned to a publication, edition, or installment. Commonly used for magazines, journals, and periodical issues.

definitions.gloss: designation number, name (of a ship, train, typhoon, etc.)
definitions.explanation: A number or name used to identify a specific ship, train service, typhoon, space mission, or other named entity.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}{号|ごう}を{読|よ}む。
その{雑誌|ざっし}の{三月|さんがつ}{号|ごう}は{売|う}り{切|き}れだった。
examples.english: The March issue of that magazine was sold out.

examples.japanese: {創刊|そうかん}{号|ごう}は{今|いま}ではプレミアがついて{高値|たかね}で{取引|とりひき}されている。
examples.english: The inaugural issue now commands a premium and is traded at high prices.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}{十|じゅう}{号|ごう}が{接近|せっきん}している。
のぞみ{一|いち}{号|ごう}に{乗|の}って{東京|とうきょう}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: I headed to Tokyo on Nozomi No. 1.

examples.japanese: アポロ{十一|じゅういち}{号|ごう}は{人類|じんるい}で{初|はじ}めて{月|つき}に{着陸|ちゃくりく}した{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}だ。
examples.english: Apollo 11 was the first spacecraft to land humans on the moon.

notes:
USAGE:
{号|ごう} is typically used as a suffix attached to numbers or names. It functions similarly to English "No." or "issue" but is used much more broadly in Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {〜月|がつ}{号|ごう}: the [month] issue (magazines)
- {第|だい}〜{号|ごう}: issue/number ~ (formal numbering)
- {創刊|そうかん}{号|ごう}: inaugural/first issue
- {最新|さいしん}{号|ごう}: latest issue
- {台風|たいふう}{〜号|ごう}: typhoon number ~

NOTE:
Not to be confused with the suffix {〜号|ごう} used for room numbers ({三〇五|さんまるご}{号室|ごうしつ} "room 305") or dress sizes.
